The '''Sigil system''' was the source of the expensive and dangerous [[Sigil (crystal)|sigil]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Sigil aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].
